# Lista06

```{r setup}
#install.packages("RSQLite")
library(RSQLite)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r inicio}
path <- ("dataset")
fname <- file.path(path, "disco.db")

conn <- dbConnect(SQLite(), fname)

#Listando os bancos
dbListTables(conn)
```

```{r}
dbListFields(conn, "customers")
```

```{r}
dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT COUNT(CustomerId) AS N_clientes FROM customers")
```

```{r}
dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(Country)) AS N_Paises FROM customers")
```

```{r}
dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT country, COUNT(*) as quantidade FROM customers
           GROUP BY country
           ORDER BY quantidade DESC")
```

```{r}
dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT country, COUNT(*) as Quantidade_Clientes FROM customers
           GROUP BY country
           ORDER BY Quantidade_Clientes DESC
           LIMIT 5")
```

```{r}
dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT DISTINCT(country) FROM customers
           WHERE LENGTH(country) = 6")
#Utilizei Length porque não consegui utilizar o GLOB pois dava um erro.
```

```{r}
dificil <- dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT DISTINCT tracks.Name FROM customers
           INNER JOIN invoices ON customers.CustomerId = invoices.CustomerId
           INNER JOIN invoice_items ON invoices.InvoiceId = invoice_items.InvoiceId
           INNER JOIN tracks ON invoice_items.TrackId = tracks.TrackId
           WHERE customers.Country = 'Brazil' ")
knitr::kable(dificil)
```

```{r}
Sys.setenv(TZ = "America/Sao_Paulo")
Sys.time()
```
